text.description_html:
RK International SD-CK3AC-2, Clear Acrylic Diamond Shower Handle

This Diamond Cut Shower Door Knob is made from clear acrylic for long-lasting beauty that will remain crystal-clear for many years to come. This knobset comes with everything you need to install it on a glass shower door including 2 knobs and the mounting hardware. The Clear Acrylic Diamond Shower Handle is the perfect finishing touch to any bathroom. It catches light beautifully in its diamond cut design. It is available in polished brass, polished chrome, satin nickel, and oil rubbed bronze.

Specifications and Features of the SD-CK3AC-2 Clear Acrylic Diamond Shower Knob Pair:

  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Rosette Diameter: 1-3/32"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Material: acrylic with a brass rose
  • Door Thickness: 1/4" - 1/2"
  • Glass Hole Diameter: 5/16" to 3/8"

Packaged with 2 crystal knobs and includes all the hardware for back to back mounting (2 knobs bolt to each other through the shower door) on up to 1/2" thick glass shower door.

Sold as a Pair - 2 Crystal Knobs (1 knob for each side of the glass)
